episodes.name: Enter the Iron Friends
episodes.overviewEn: Tony promises his friends a park day, but Ultron steals the toys.

episodes.name: Amadeus Cho's Eggcellent Eggventure!
episodes.overviewEn: Amadeus upgrades a truck, but accidentally turns it into a giant chicken!

episodes.name: Great Expo-tations
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends must save the pier—then stop Ultron from turning Stark Expo into Ultron Expo!

episodes.name: Bouncy Boots
episodes.overviewEn: Absorbing Man steals the power of bouncy boots.

episodes.name: Totally Awesome Beach Day
episodes.overviewEn: Ultron crashes beach day to build his HQ, and the Iron Friends must stop him.

episodes.name: Swarm Stinks It Up
episodes.overviewEn: the Iron Friends race to save Granny Williams' peach pies from Swarm's stink bugs.

episodes.name: The Ultron Song
episodes.overviewEn: Ultron takes over the airwaves, and the Iron Friends must stop him.

episodes.name: Black Panther and the Boot
episodes.overviewEn: A visit from T'Challa turns tense when a device threatens his suit and the IQ.

episodes.name: Captain America Goes Fast
episodes.overviewEn: Ultron steals Cap’s power-pack and goes turbo.

episodes.name: Ironheart's Awesome Playground
episodes.overviewEn: Riri's playground plans are bugged by Swarm's power-draining robo-mosquitoes.

episodes.name: Tony and the Rolling Stones
episodes.overviewEn: Tony tries to move a boulder blocking the trail.

episodes.name: Ironheart's Muddy Adventure
episodes.overviewEn: Riri wants to play paper boats, but Swarm has drained the creek to ruin the park.

episodes.name: Welcome to Wakanda
episodes.overviewEn: In Wakanda, Ultron steals Black Panther's tech and must be stopped.

episodes.name: Puppy Dog Fun
episodes.overviewEn: At Doggy Adoption Day, Swarm uses collars to cause chaos with the pups.

episodes.name: Ironheart's Baseball Blast
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends must stop Absorbing Man, who steals a pitching machine to wreak havoc.

episodes.name: Swarm the IQ
episodes.overviewEn: Amadeus plans a bioluminescent wave party, but Swarm shows up to cause trouble at the IQ.

episodes.name: Iron Friends Trick or Treats!
episodes.overviewEn: Amadeus uses a robot costume for Halloween, but it goes on a candy rampage.

episodes.name: Leaping into Fall
episodes.overviewEn: Swarm steals all the pumpkins, and the team must get them back.

episodes.name: Special Delivery for the Iron Friends
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends must stop delivery bots that have gone rogue.

episodes.name: The Fix-It Bot Fiasco
episodes.overviewEn: Tony, Riri, and Amadeus try to fix Howard Stark’s failed invention, but it causes chaos at Stark Expo.

episodes.name: Baby Vision
episodes.overviewEn: When Ultron turns Vision into a baby, the Iron Friends must retrieve the device to fix him.

episodes.name: Ironheart's Racing Adventure
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends team up to stop Swarm and her Slime Bugs from ruining a car show.

episodes.name: Iron Hulk and the Bees
episodes.overviewEn: Amadeus shows off his high-tech bee hive, but when Swarm attacks, the Iron Friends must save the day and the bees.

episodes.name: Fly Away Iron Friends
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends stop Ultron from making everyone float away.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends Go Camping
episodes.overviewEn: While camping, the Iron Friends track down missing snacks.

episodes.name: Swarm and Bugs Go to a Concert
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends must stop Swarm's Robo-Crickets from ruining Howard's concert and wreaking havoc at Stark Expo.

episodes.name: Redwing's First Flight
episodes.overviewEn: Cap and Iron Man struggle to work as a team when Ultron hits the mall.

episodes.name: Absorbing Man Gets Shiny
episodes.overviewEn: Absorbing Man steals a gem that deflects the Iron Friends' beams, forcing them to find a new way to stop him.

episodes.name: An Iron Friends Christmas
episodes.overviewEn: When Ultron steals all the presents, the Iron Friends must save Christmas.

episodes.name: Cold As Ice
episodes.overviewEn: Ana and Tony head to the Winter Festival, but Absorbing Man freezes the whole event.

episodes.name: The Tale of Hawkeye
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends head to Beachside Mall, where Hawkeye reveals Absorbing Man is behind the thefts.

episodes.name: Iron Sleepover
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends' sleepover is interrupted by Ultron, who steals the Arc Reactor.

episodes.name: Ultron Ruins Valentine's Day
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends stop Ultron's teddy bears from ruining Valentine's Day.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends and the Trouble at the Tar Pits
episodes.overviewEn: The trio must save the mammoth exhibit when Swarm and Absorbing Man cause chaos at the tar pit museum.

episodes.name: Absorbing Man's Magnetic Mayhem
episodes.overviewEn: Absorbing Man gains magnetism and threatens Stark Expo.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends and the Baby Birds
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends protect a bird's nest from Swarm's "Paint Bugs" attack.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends vs. the Iron Fiends
episodes.overviewEn: When Iron Friend imposters cause chaos, the team must clear their names.

episodes.name: Vision's Invisible Trouble
episodes.overviewEn: Vision's art tour turns dangerous as Ultron threatens to make the museum vanish.

episodes.name: Enter the Giant-Sized Iron Friends
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends use giant-sized armour to battle Ultron in his Ultimo Suit.

episodes.name: The Mighty Thor and Mischievous Loki
episodes.overviewEn: When Thor visits, Loki causes trouble, and the kids armor up to stop him and save the city.

episodes.name: The Caves of Wakanda
episodes.overviewEn: Ultron steals Vibranium to power his Robotic Racer.

episodes.name: Swarm's Lightning Bug Blast
episodes.overviewEn: Swarm ruins the hover scooter launch at Stark Expo, and the team must stop her Lightning Bugs from glitching their suits.

episodes.name: Gamma's Birthday
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends plan Gamma's birthday, but Ultron ruins it by showing up in a giant unicorn piñata.

episodes.name: Ultron vs. Absorbing Man
episodes.overviewEn: Iron Man and Ironheart must retrieve a stolen arc reactor and save the day.

episodes.name: Hawkeye and the Super Smelly Stink Arrows
episodes.overviewEn: Hawkeye and Iron Man must stop Ultron from using stink arrows to take over the pier.

episodes.name: Loki's Movie Mania
episodes.overviewEn: Loki brings Riri's favorite sci-fi film to life.

episodes.name: Game On
episodes.overviewEn: Loki brings Riri's favorite game to life, and she must defeat the villain to win.

episodes.name: Let's Go Fly an Iron Kite
episodes.overviewEn: Swarm's Robotic Bot-terflies threaten a perfect day for flying kites at the beach.

episodes.name: Wonders of Wakanda
episodes.overviewEn: Tony and Scott help T'Challa set up a Vibranium exhibit at Stark Expo, but Ultron steals it.

episodes.name: Thor and Loki Hit the Road
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends and Thor race to retrieve stolen RC racers from Loki.

episodes.name: Giant-Man and the Iron Lighthouse
episodes.overviewEn: Swarm and her Robo-Moths steal a lighthouse beacon.

episodes.name: Thor and the Frost Giant
episodes.overviewEn: When Loki enchants a water park mascot, Iron Man and Thor must stop it.

episodes.name: Sticky Fingers
episodes.overviewEn: Absorbing Man uses sticky honey to steal everything at the Farmer's Market.

episodes.name: Swarm's Baseball Swing and a Mess
episodes.overviewEn: Riri, Tony, and Amadeus help build a baseball field, but Swarm's Pop Flies threaten it.

episodes.name: Thor and the Legends of Asgard
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends visit Thor in Asgard, only for Ultron to try ruling the realm.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends and the Hot Air Balloons
episodes.overviewEn: Swarm crashes a hot air balloon festival with her Robotic Needlenose Bugs.

episodes.name: Giant-Sized Iron Pup
episodes.overviewEn: Gamma and a squirrel grow giant after being hit with Pym Particles.

episodes.name: Loki's Monorail Trouble
episodes.overviewEn: The team chases Loki to stop the enchanted monorail.

episodes.name: Swarm Visits the Pier
episodes.overviewEn: Aña joins Tony, Riri, and Scott at the pier, but Swarm's robo-crabs cause a shellfish mess.

episodes.name: Ultron Says
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends armor up to stop Ultron's "Ultron Says" ray from controlling the city.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends and the Mystery of the Pier
episodes.overviewEn: A mysterious prankster steals the bumper cars from the pier.

episodes.name: Absorbing Man's Hiccup Change-Up
episodes.overviewEn: Absorbing Man gets hiccups and uncontrollably switches forms.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends Capture the Flag
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends must recover their IQ's Arc Reactor after Ultron steals it.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends and the Giant Peach Tree
episodes.overviewEn: Loki steals Granny Williams's peaches and enchants them to sprout trees across the city.

episodes.name: Swarm's Underground Shakedown
episodes.overviewEn: Swarm causes chaos at the mall with her bugs.

episodes.name: The Iron Friends in Space
episodes.overviewEn: Tony, Vision, and Riri visit the Moon Museum, and Absorbing Man steals a shuttle to the moon.

episodes.name: Bubble Bubble Ultron Trouble
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends are enjoying a bubble day when Ultron shows up with his Unpoppable Bubbles.

episodes.name: The Winged Horses of Asgard
episodes.overviewEn: Thor welcomes Tony and Riri to Asgard, and Loki releases Odin's winged horses.

episodes.name: Swarm's Robo Termite Takeover
episodes.overviewEn: The Iron Friends must save the hiking trail from Swarm's Robo Termites.

episodes.name: Ultron Traps The Iron Friends
episodes.overviewEn: Ultron traps Tony, Riri, and Amadeus in their rooms at the IQ with Super Robotic Shields.

episodes.name: Absorbing Man and the Super Strong Vibranium
episodes.overviewEn: Absorbing Man absorbs super-strong Vibranium.

episodes.name: Captain America and Loki's Shield Chase
episodes.overviewEn: Loki steals Captain America's shield and makes it giant-sized.
